raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Jimmy is persistent with the narrative that I'm the leader. I have 3 VP and 2 Knights, which puts me in a strong position for Largest Army, but I genuinely lack the Brick to expand. He's trying to deflect from his own potential. I should stay cool and not get into a shouting match, just a light deflection.","note_to_self":"Jimmy is successfully framing me as the leader due to my 2 Knights. I have 4 Sheep and a 3:1 port, so I can convert for a Brick next turn if needed.","say_outloud":"ג'ימי, אבן אחת זה נחמד, אבל עם אבן לא בונים כבישים או יישובים. האבירים רק שומרים עליי שלא יגנבו לי את המעט שיש."}
